purpose: Record an independently measured correction to a single reachability classification in RE_U4_COMMERCIAL_V1_JOURNEY_DELTA_v1.0.0.json (golden_journey.INITIAL_ONBOARDING and fail_closed_matrix.incomplete_onboarding), identified by the independent RE_SAFE_NOW_INTEGRATION_REVIEW.
scope_note: DERIVED TRACKING RECORD. This addendum does NOT edit, rewrite, or restate docs/ops/reeng/RE_U4_COMMERCIAL_V1_JOURNEY_DELTA_v1.0.0.json, which remains byte-identical historical evidence of the earlier materialization. It supersedes ONLY the specific reachability classification identified below — not the entire RE-U4 artifact, not any other finding, not any Q1-Q6 disposition, and not any FIB/PC-01B/IM-01B/ODS authority. Creates no new product authority, implements no runtime remediation (see RE_U4_CF_01.owner_stage), and reopens no frozen decision.

correction_source.original_reasoning_gap: The original RE-U4 record considered forward invitation ordering (no member can be invited before phase 2 completes, because the inviter is itself blocked by OnboardingCheck) but did not consider organizations already affected by migration 0036 at the time it was applied — i.e. pre-existing organizations whose onboarding_completed defaulted to false with no backfill, and any non-admin member who already belonged to such an organization.

measured_facts.fact: migration 0036 (db/migrations/0036_phase2_onboarding.sql) added organizations.onboarding_completed boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL
migration 0036 contains no backfill statement for pre-existing organizations; only two ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN statements
components/auth/OnboardingCheck.tsx redirects any authenticated org member whose onboardingCompleted is false to /app/organization/onboarding, unconditionally on role
app/app/organization/onboarding/page.tsx (the Phase-2 page) performs no role check of its own — it renders the calibration form to any authenticated member OnboardingCheck routes there
completeOnboarding (app/actions/onboarding.ts) calls requireOrganizationAccess() and then throws 'Only organization admins can complete onboarding' for any non-admin caller
a non-admin member can therefore reach a form (Phase-2 onboarding) that they are authorized to view but not authorized to successfully submit

the Phase-2 page currently renders no exit, sign-out, or support-contact affordance of its own (no href, no signout control) — confirmed by direct read of app/app/organization/onboarding/page.tsx this session
server authorization in completeOnboarding remains correct: it refuses the write, it does not weaken the admin-only gate

RE_U4_CF_01.classification: this is not an authorization bypass — the server-side gate holds — this is a reachable remediation/dead-end defect: a non-admin can be routed to a form with no way to complete it and no way to leave it

corrected_golden_journey_INITIAL_ONBOARD.FAIL_CLOSED_STATE: completeOnboarding throws 'Only organization admins can complete onboarding' for a non-admin caller; OnboardingCheck force-redirects ANY member of an uncalibrated organization to this route regardless of role — this is REACHABLE, not merely latent, for organizations whose onboarding_completed defaulted to false under migration 0036 with no backfill, and for any org where a non-admin member already exists in an uncalibrated organization. The page renders no exit/support affordance of its own.
corrected_golden_journey_INITIAL_ONBOARD.REMEDIATION_PATH: non-admin trapped case: contact the organization_admin to complete calibration; owned by RE_U4_HARDENING for a minimal runtime remediation (e.g. exit/support affordance on the Phase-2 page, or a role-aware notice) — not implemented by this addendum

corrected_meaning.statement: 'has_remedy = true' in the original record is imprecise for a non-admin. Routing is not the same as a usable remedy when the destination cannot be completed or exited by the routed user.
corrected_meaning.ADMIN_USER: has a reachable completion remedy — can submit the Phase-2 form and complete onboarding.
corrected_meaning.NON_ADMIN_USER: does NOT currently have an effective completion or exit/support remedy on the Phase-2 page itself; the only remedy is out-of-band (ask an organization_admin to complete calibration, or navigate away manually).

no_runtime_change.statement: This addendum is a documentation-only correction. No route, component, server action, or database object was modified to produce it.
